production_characteristics: C ABI boundary between Rust control plane and C++ durable engine
transaction lifecycle and MVCC version catalog with reachable history auditing
operator STATS and HEALTH surfaces backed by catalog, transaction and durable-path audits
binary key/value protocol with explicit size limits

stateful_dataset_exemption.reason: StoneVault is an embedded general-purpose storage engine whose persisted keys and values are arbitrary caller-owned binary bytes, not a fixed business-domain record corpus. Shipping 10,000-20,000 invented business rows would be decorative and would not participate in normal engine behavior. Production statefulness is instead exercised through the reachable WAL, MVCC catalog, snapshots, transactions and restart/recovery paths using deterministic verifier-created state.

domain_state_model: MVCC committed-version catalog and history audit
active transaction overlays and transaction-table audit
writer lock and operator-visible durable-path health/statistics
production_authenticity.reachability_evidence: All declared state is created, inspected or consumed through /app/stonevault/bin/stonevault and its documented transaction, STATS, HEALTH, checkpoint and recovery paths; STATS executes the runtime audit layer even in the starter, so the added integrity logic is not dead authoring scale.

reachability_note: All listed production modules participate in the production build path. The expanded catalog/transaction/storage audit code is reached by STATS in the starter and by both STATS and repaired HEALTH in the Oracle candidate; semantic reachability remains subject to Q6.
